tier1_validator.description: Pattern-based validation - uses predefined patterns for standard variable types
tier1_validator.use_case: Variables with high confidence pattern match (>=0.8), low cardinality (<=7 unique values)

tier2_batch.description: Semi-standard batch processing - LLM processes multiple variables in a single call
tier2_batch.use_case: Variables with medium confidence, moderate cardinality (categorical with many values)

tier3_individual.description: Complex individual processing - detailed LLM analysis per variable
tier3_individual.use_case: Complex variables, open-ended text, ambiguous types requiring deep analysis
